test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing towards centre (not necessarily in the same order). R sits to the immediate left of W and third to the left of P. Only two friends sit between P and S. Q sits to the immediate left of V.

What is the position of T with respect to S ?
solution:
**Given: **Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing towards centre.

1) R sits to the immediate left of W and third to the left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/688cdec4716e836ac7fbd4b95cefab41cfb62f6958fed61729ebbe3719f4c5cc.png] 

2) Only two friends sit between P and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8710a08397b71e8486fd73b04882a3550347d01e099146be97df0f62bf09c8fa.png] 

3) Q sits to the immediate left of V.

After positioning Q and V only one position is left which will be occupied by the only boy left i.e. T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/100fdf936f914e74dfe0aeda9d0646e805730320647ea7f95f0e7531cb31eda8.png] 

Thus, T is third to the right of S.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
